name: The Metal Guy LLC
old_description: Expert metal craftsmen with current experience in the marine trades work onsite at Safe Harbor Newport Shipyard. Welding and cutting machinery assure accurate fabrication and efficiency. Shipyard cranes provide the ability to move and manipulate massive plates and structures.
about:
The Metal Guy LLC operates onsite at Safe Harbor Newport Shipyard in Newport, Rhode Island. The limited‑liability company provides metal fabrication and repair services to the shipyard’s military and commercial clients. No founding year or ownership structure is disclosed in public materials; the business is identified by its trade name, TMG Newport, and a single point of contact, Kevin.

The shop specializes in marine alloys, working with aluminum, stainless steel, cupro‑nickel, duplex stainless, high‑nickel alloys, and bronze. Its craftsmen handle tubing, piping, and flat‑plate work both on board vessels and in the shop. Welding and cutting machinery support the fabrication process, while the shipyard’s cranes allow the team to move and position massive plates and structural assemblies.

Customers include military and commercial vessel owners, refit projects, and other onsite trades at the Newport Shipyard. The Metal Guy’s work spans new construction, repair, and refit scenarios where corrosion‑resistant alloys and precise fit‑up are required. The company does not publish a client list, but its location inside a full‑service shipyard places it alongside machine, electrical, and carpentry shops serving the same fleet.

The firm emphasizes its craftsmen’s current marine‑trades experience and breadth of alloy expertise as differentiators. Access to shipyard lifting equipment and the ability to work either dockside or in a controlled shop environment are cited as reasons customers engage TMG Newport for complex marine fabrication.
